name: webdev-template-python
description: Bun and Next.js frontend with a FastAPI and uv backend.

scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd frontend --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --directory backend --locked
scripts.dev: bun --bun concurrently --kill-others --kill-timeout 3000 --names web,api "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.check: bun run check:web && bun run check:api
scripts.check:api: uv run --directory backend --locked ruff check . && uv run --directory backend --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --directory backend --locked pytest
scripts.test:smoke: bun --bun concurrently --kill-others --kill-timeout 3000 --success command-smoke --names web,api,smoke "bun run start:web" "bun run start:api" "bun scripts/smoke.mjs"
